documents.title: Gitea API reference
documents.description: A Sourcey-generated, navigable reference for the Gitea REST API, built from source at a pinned commit.
documents.searchText: # gitea api reference {#gitea-api-reference} is a self-hosted git service written in go. this site [sourcey](https://sourcey.com)-generated documentation set built directly from gitea's own openapi description, so every endpoint, parameter and schema on the **api reference** tab taken source rather than retyped. ## {#the-source-this-site-is-built-from} | item value --- repository [go-gitea/gitea](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea) pinned commit `4f5a3e13e5f3aca85d830e3a9024c893b0bbf1e1` (release tag `v28.3.0`) spec file `templates/swagger/v1-openapi3.generated.json` format 3.0.3 license mit (see `license` repository) adapter sourcey `openapi()` description generated by tooling go annotations, then published as `v1-openapi3.generated.json`. pinning to tagged release means matches code given instance runs. how use {#how-to-use-the-reference} - its search jump straight an operation, request body or response schema. operation lists http method, path, parameters, documented responses. authentication described seven security schemes [coverage](/gitea-api-docs/coverage) for count). practice you send either `authorization: token <token>` header `token` query parameter. what does not claim {#what-this-site-does-and-does-not-claim} faithful rendering of upstream at commit. where thin, thin same reason says [known gaps](/gitea-api-docs/gaps) page papering over it.

documents.title: Coverage
documents.description: What the pinned Gitea OpenAPI description actually contains, counted from the file.
documents.searchText: # coverage {#coverage} these numbers are counted directly from `templates/swagger/v1-openapi3.generated.json` at commit `4f5a3e13e5f3aca85d830e3a9024c893b0bbf1e1` (tag `v28.3.0`). they describe the documented surface, not whole of gitea. | concept count --- paths 342 operations (method + path) 537 tag groups 9 reusable schemas (`components.schemas`) 234 security schemes 7 deprecated 4 ## by {#operations-by-tag} gitea its api into nine tags. counts below per tag, spec: repository 222 user 93 organization 83 issue 72 admin 33 miscellaneous 14 package notification settings {#security-schemes} description declares seven schemes: `accesstoken`, `authorizationheadertoken`, `basicauth`, `sudoheader`, `sudoparam`, `totpheader` and `token`. six `apikey` one (`basicauth`) is http basic auth. servers {#servers} spec's `servers` entry a build placeholder, `/gitea-api-app-suburl/api/v1`. real deployment serves under own instance url, for example `https://gitea.example.com/api/v1`. see [known gaps](/gitea-api-docs/gaps) why this matters to codegen tools.

documents.title: Known gaps
documents.description: Concrete, maintainer-facing gaps found in the pinned Gitea OpenAPI description, each reproducible from the file.
documents.searchText: # known gaps {#known-gaps} these are real in the pinned description (`templates/swagger/v1-openapi3.generated.json` at `4f5a3e13e5f3aca85d830e3a9024c893b0bbf1e1`). each one is reproducible from file; counts were produced with a small json script over spec. they listed here because generated reference can only be as complete its source. - **most operations have no `description`.** 516 of 537 (about 96%) carry `summary` but `description`. for example `get /repos/{owner}/{repo}` has `summary: "get repository"` and `description`; /admin/cron` "list cron tasks"` one-line summary enough to label page, not explain scopes, pagination or side effects. **error responses often undocumented.** 55 declare `4xx` `5xx` response all. clients spec therefore typed error surface those endpoints, even though gitea returns structured api errors practice. **some schemas 36 234 reusable `components.schemas` `description`, so reader sees field list prose about what object represents. **one security scheme description.** seven schemes, `basicauth` without other six their usage. **the `version` build placeholder.** `info.version` `0.0.0+gitea-api-app-version`. version substituted time, taken source tree does release number, which makes it hard tell downloaded file describes. `servers` url `servers[0].url` `/gitea-api-app-suburl/api/v1`. code generators that trust will emit base path instance uses; documented `{suburl}` variable would make usable editing. **deprecated migration note.** four marked `deprecated` (for `post /org/{org}/repos` issue-comment `delete`/`patch` pair), none them points replacement, cannot migrate to. **there `externaldocs` link.** top-level `externaldocs`, there in-spec pointer human guide concepts leaves out. ## good shape {#what-is-in-good-shape} every operation stable `operationid` (0 missing). non-path parameter `description` all nine tag groups declared description. valid openapi 3.0.3 parses cleanly.
